title: C5 persistent relational full loop
question: Can the C5 sparse funnel route to a target that must be compositionally derived from temporally persistent state, when the public query does not contain the target descriptor and the relevance relation is not direct Hamming proximity?
hypothesis: A state-aware CDL router trained on post-action outcomes can learn the persistent relational mapping and feed bounded CASM verification, while resetting persistent state should collapse routing capability toward chance.

arms.name: persistent_relational
arms.intervention: read temporally committed operands and operation from persistent state during noisy query routing and CASM verification

arms.name: reset_control
arms.intervention: clear the persistent state before routing

arms.name: operand_hamming_reference
arms.intervention: rank candidates by Hamming distance to either persisted operand

arms.name: persistent_composition_oracle
arms.intervention: derive the relation from persisted operands and operation without learning

decision_rule.condition: Report persistent and reset dense routing across every registered M. Do not tune M or training based on held-out results.
decision_rule.licenses: workload-specific evidence about whether the learned router uses the persistent relational state.
decision_rule.does_not_license: a general claim about memory or semantic intelligence.

decision_rule.condition: Report the complete calibration-derived sparse funnel at every M, including K90 and measured LSH geometry.
decision_rule.licenses: separation of representation, admission, and execution effects in the persistent relational workload.

decision_rule.condition: The target descriptor must never be stored in persistent state, query text, or verifier-side task metadata.
decision_rule.does_not_license: a result on arbitrary hidden-state tasks.

decision_rule.condition: The temporal state must be unavailable before its registered delay and readable after the delay despite intervening writes.

held_constant: four boolean relations: XOR, XNOR, AND, OR
target generated from persisted operands and operation, never stored
state write delay of 3 decision boundaries
64 calibration and 64 held-out trials per seed/M
CASM and verifier budget of four admitted execution attempts
verified online updates only after successful execution and verification
